source.citation: Shahbazi, Menard, Sohn, Theau (2019), Unmanned aerial image dataset: Ready for 3D reconstruction. Data in Brief 25, 103962. DOI 10.1016/j.dib.2019.103962

processing.method: Deterministic stride sample from valid XYZ rows, split into 4x4 binary float32 scene-coordinate tiles.

sceneTransform.note: Tiled preview keeps TLS metric scale, recenters X/Y, and lifts Z into the existing procedural Case Study B scene.

reviewStatus.notes: This is a higher-density browser preview rail, not a full-resolution Potree/EPT conversion. Full LaserScan.xyz still requires dedicated point-cloud conversion before final use.
